summary: Current universal-worker execution does not yet enforce one auditable role-sensitive context contract. The repository already contains a deterministic Context Fabric Lite P1 candidate and an earlier receipt canary, but later material runs still range from a strong L0/L1/L2 receipt to a partial ad-hoc receipt to no context_receipt in the run at all. Therefore automated Context Fabric use is not operational and context sufficiency cannot be inferred from successful task completion.

binding_contract.operational_law: A mechanism is not operational merely because its design or implementation exists; actual use requires durable receipts.

runtime_sample.observation: Contains actor_role, mission, L0, L1, L2 exact refs, freshness identities, authority labels, contradictions and a bounded budget note. It demonstrates the target receipt shape is feasible in live worker execution.

Contains a loaded-file list, collision result and authority label, but does not express the complete mandatory L0/L1/L2/omissions/freshness/contradiction/budget contract. The build can still be useful evidence, but its context selection is not fully auditable under the binding receipt contract.

Terminal DONE run records mission/checkpoints/authority but no context_receipt object. This proves receipt enforcement is not universal on material worker paths. It does not by itself prove the worker read insufficient context; it proves that sufficiency cannot be audited from required durable evidence.

existing_mechanisms.evidence: Defines the strict receipt contract, deterministic evaluator, gold set, hard correctness gates and selected-vs-scan efficiency gate. Its own result is PARTIAL_EXPECTED_FAILURE because automated compiler provenance and the repository-scan denominator were not proven.

Implements deterministic inventory, sparse explicit graph, exact+lexical retrieval, mandatory closure, context compiler and durable receipt payload; isolated tests PASS 12/12. The return explicitly says Context Fabric is NOT_PROMOTED and live full-repository efficiency was NOT_RUN.
Already establishes Context Fabric Lite / deterministic progressive disclosure as the preferred P1 route and moves durable context receipts earlier in the implementation order.

findings.finding: The main gap is adoption/enforcement: material workers can finish with inconsistent or absent context receipts even after the candidate compiler and receipt contract exist.
findings.consequence: Prometeo cannot currently distinguish a genuinely task-sufficient role-sensitive context selection from accidental success, manual over-reading or silent omission using durable evidence alone.

findings.finding: A strong live receipt pattern already exists in Local Steward recovery, so the missing capability is not representational expressiveness.
findings.consequence: Do not spend the next cycle redesigning receipt schema or another context architecture.

findings.finding: Under-context cannot be concluded solely from a missing receipt, and over-context/bloat is not quantitatively proven because the live full-repository selected-vs-scan denominator has not been run.
findings.consequence: Treat both as falsification targets for the live canary, not as established runtime facts.

findings.finding: Current context selection provenance is heterogeneous: manual/declared scope remains in live use while an AUTOMATED_CONTEXT_COMPILER candidate exists but has not been operationally adopted.
findings.consequence: Mechanism status should remain CANARY_PARTIAL/DESIGNED_NOT_USED on paths lacking automated provenance, even when task output is useful.

stop: Do not design another Context Fabric architecture.
Do not promote Context Fabric from candidate evidence based on isolated 12/12 tests alone.
Do not treat DONE/RETURN as proof that context selection was sufficient.
Do not claim context bloat reduction without a pinned live denominator.
start: Exercise the already-built P1 compiler on pinned live-repository missions before substantive work.
Persist compiler-generated receipts and evaluate them independently against the existing receipt canary contract.
Measure both hard critical-source recall and selected file/token reduction.
After a passing live canary, add validator enforcement so material runs lacking a valid receipt are flagged rather than silently treated as context-proven.

deduplicated_next_work.mission: Run Context Fabric Lite P1 against a pinned live repository for representative BUILD, CRITIQUE and SURFACE missions; emit AUTOMATED_CONTEXT_COMPILER receipts before material work; independently evaluate critical-source/authority/contradiction/freshness gates and selected-vs-scan file/token reduction; exercise stale-head invalidation across a real main advance.
acceptance: critical required-source recall is complete under the existing gold/evaluator contract
authority and contradiction hard gates pass
stale-head mutation is rejected or forces recompilation
pinned repository denominator exists and observed file/token reduction is recorded
no Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is inferred from worker completion
